items.title: Berenberg Just Cut Its AST SpaceMobile Target From $92 to $30
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBerenberg downgraded AST SpaceMobile to Hold from Buy and cut its price target to $30 from $92, citing satellite launch delays. Three BlueBirds are still waiting on a launch date from SpaceX, and the next three are booked on Blue Origin’s New Glenn, which hasn’t flown since an explosion on its pad in May.

items.title: Starlink Mobile Reached 3M+ Kazakh Users in “Cellular Dead Zones” in Under Two Months. Bad News for AST SpaceMobile
items.summary: Key TakeawaysStarlink said more than 3 million Beeline Kazakhstan customers are using Starlink Mobile in cellular dead zones less than two months after launch. SpaceX is showing that a carrier partner can scale satellite phone service fast, while AST SpaceMobile still lacks the satellites it needs for continuous coverage.
